name: app-mobility-app-on-bike-handlebar-lime
title: Mobility app mounted on a bike handlebar over giant lime wordmark
whatItIs: A phone mounted on a black bike handlebar, filling a lime background with a huge faint wordmark behind. The screen shows a map with green pins and a bottom sheet offering Cars and Scooters and a search bar.
whatItMeans: Energetic and street-smart; putting the phone in its real use context sells the product.
techniques: Place the device in its real environment (bike) to tell the use story.
Fill the backdrop with a lime tint and a giant faint wordmark.
Use bright green map pins to echo the brand colour.
Crop the frame so the phone is centred with symmetrical hardware.

vocabulary.definition: A device shown in the environment where it will be used.
An oversized low-contrast brand name behind content.
Brand-coloured markers on a neutral map.
